name: Marico Ltd
title: Marico Ltd - 531642 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Marico guides FY27 double-digit revenue to cross INR15,000 crore and high-teen EBITDA growth, helped by copra down ~35% from peak, but crude-linked inputs still rising and no capacity signal.

triggers.label: Smaller peers supply-constrained, Marico advantaged
triggers.quote: a smaller player's response times, ability to foresee these would be lower

triggers.label: FY27 high-teen EBITDA growth guided
triggers.quote: we would target to deliver about high teens EBITDA growth, which, in fact, is slightly higher than what we had guided in the previous call

triggers.label: VAHO price up 6-7% on crude derivatives
triggers.quote: we already have taken about 6% to 7% price increase in response to whatever increase we have seen in crude derivatives

guidance.quote: We expect to sustain high single -digit volume growth in the India business in FY '27.

guidance.value: double-digit growth to cross INR15,000 crore
guidance.quote: we aim to deliver double -digit revenue growth to cross INR15,000 crores in revenues and high -teen EBITDA growth, subject to stable macros.
if situations were to normalize, we would target to deliver about high teens EBITDA growth, which, in fact, is slightly higher than what we had guided in the previous call
we are saying about 150 basis points expansion

guidance.metric: Gross margin expansion vs FY26 exit
guidance.quote: about 300 to 400 basis points improvement over the exit of FY '26 is fairly possible
it will be in the range of at least 20% to 25%, if not more
you could consider around 20% or so

guidance.metric: Premium Personal Care EBITDA margin exit FY27
guidance.quote: we aim to exit FY '27 at a double -digit EBITDA margins and eventually teens EBITDA margins in FY '30

guidance.metric: Foods+PPC share of India business FY27
guidance.quote: We expect the share of these new businesses to expand to about 27%, which was earlier targeted to reach 25% in FY '27
The international business is expected to maintain strong momentum and mid-teen constant currency growth

red_flags.label: Crude-linked input inflation uncertainty
red_flags.quote: vegetable oils and other crude-linked inputs continue to exhibit an upward bias driven by ongoing geopolitical tensions in the Middle East

evasions.quote: Pawan Agrawal: Vivek, I think we would be the only company who would be giving this kind of a guidance
instead of cross subsidizing, we have a kind of a competitive advantage this year
